WITH school_counts AS (
  SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count
  FROM frpm
  WHERE `Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
    AND `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
),
ranked_schools AS (
  SELECT 
    f.`School Name`,
    f.`District Name`,
    f.`County Name`,
    f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`,
    CAST(SCO.total_count AS INTEGER) * 0.1 as threshold_count,
    (
      SELECT COUNT(*) + 1 
      FROM frpm f2 
      WHERE f2.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
        AND f2.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` > f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
        AND f2.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
    ) as rank_in_year
  FROM frpm f
  CROSS JOIN school_counts SCO
  WHERE f.`Academic Year` = '2014-2015'
    AND f.`Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
  `School Name`,
  `District Name`,
  `County Name`,
  `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)`
FROM ranked_schools
WHERE rank_in_year <= threshold_count
ORDER BY `Percent (%) Eligible FRPM (K-12)` DESC;
